content.value: Calculate the NOl for a residential building from the following table (10) where the annual income and expenditures are given. Also calculate the entry Cap rate i, when the purchase price is 900,000 tk.

Unit 12 Rent/unit/month 1,200 tk. Vacancy 10% Property management fee 10% Income from Laundry 5,000 tk. Income from Parking 5,000 tk. Income from Bill-board 2,500 tk. Income from Advertisement 2,500 tk. Insurance 5,000 tk. Property taxes 14,000 tk. Maintenance cost 14,000 tk. Utilities expenses 20,000 tk. Rent control expenses 1,000 tk.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2016
